variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Dart is strongly typed but allows type inference using 'var'. 'final' variables can be set only once; 'const' are compile-time constants.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: Dart 2.12+ features sound null safety. Types cannot be null unless explicitly marked with a question mark (?).

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Dart includes integer division (~/), cascade notation (..), and extensive null-aware operators (??, ??=, ?.).

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: Standard C-style conditionals are used. Dart 3 introduced powerful pattern matching in switch statements and expressions.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: Supports classic for-loops, for-in loops for Iterables, and higher-order functions like forEach.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: Standard while and do-while loops operate as expected.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Functions are first-class objects. Dart supports arrow syntax (=>), optional positional arguments ([ ]), and named arguments ({ }).

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays are List objects. Dart provides collection-if and collection-for syntax to build collections dynamically.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Maps are heavily used. Keys and values are strongly typed. Accessing a key returns a nullable value (V?).

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Exceptions are handled with try-catch blocks. 'on Type' specifies which exceptions to catch, while 'catch' captures the exception object and optional stack trace.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Dart uses C-style // single-line and /* */ multi-line comments.

numbers.title: Numbers & Numerics
numbers.notes: Dart provides explicitly sized integer and floating-point primitives with binary and hex support.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Dart uses bool / boolean types with true and false literals and logical operators (&&, ||, !).

type_casting.title: Type Casting & Conversion
type_casting.notes: Dart supports explicit type casting using cast operators or constructor functions.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Dart distinguishes between single-character literals and string sequences or pointer slices.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.code:
val name = "Alice"
val score = 95
val msg = "User $name scored ${score + 5}"
string_formatting.notes: Dart supports string interpolation or printf-style formatting specifiers.

pattern_matching.title: Pattern Matching & Switch
pattern_matching.notes: Dart evaluates branching conditions through switch statements, match expressions, or when constructs.

range.title: Ranges & Slicing
range.notes: Dart represents ranges with range operators (.., ..<) or standard indexed iteration boundaries.

iterators.title: Iterators & Sequences
iterators.notes: Dart implements iteration through Iterator interfaces, generators, or range-for loops.

oop_classes.title: Classes & OOP
oop_classes.notes: Dart models object orientation through classes with constructors/encapsulation or structs with associated methods.

lists.title: Dynamic Arrays & Lists
lists.notes: Dart manages growable dynamic collections using vectors, ArrayLists, or dynamically reallocated heap buffers.

tuples.title: Tuples & Records
tuples.notes: Dart represents heterogeneous records through tuples, structured bindings, or lightweight record structs.

sets.title: Sets & Unique Collections
sets.notes: Dart provides unique collection hashing structures with O(1) average lookup and insertion time.

modules_import.title: Modules, Packages & Imports
modules_import.notes: Dart structures namespaces and external libraries via include directives, package declarations, or module imports.
